note: 探针：重画 0:03–0:09 为大提琴 / 古筝独奏

edits.title: 重画 大提琴
edits.caption: Instrumental Chinese martial arts (wuxia) battle music for a video game. The melody is played by a solo cello, bowed, deep and sustained legato in the low register, warm and resonant, over driving Chinese war drums and a staccato string ostinato. Tense and thrilling. No vocals.

edits.title: 重画 古筝
edits.caption: Instrumental Chinese martial arts (wuxia) battle music for a video game. The melody is played by a solo guzheng (Chinese zither), plucked with long ringing sustain, rich low and middle register, over driving Chinese war drums and a staccato string ostinato. Tense and thrilling. No vocals.
